sentences.japanese: あなたはあの勤め口に申し込むべきだ。
sentences.english: You should apply for that post.

sentences.japanese: 銀行に勤めている間に、彼は大学で経済学を教えた。
sentences.english: While employed at the bank, he taught economics at college.

sentences.japanese: 去年から彼はあの会社に勤めているのです。
sentences.english: He began to work for that company last year.

sentences.japanese: 海運会社に勤めています。
sentences.english: I work for a shipping company.

sentences.japanese: 我々は天然の資源を保存するように勤めなければならない。
sentences.english: We must try to conserve our natural resources.
